newsitem.title: USA: C-Cube CFO succeeded by former IC Works CFO.
newsitem.headline: C-Cube CFO succeeded by former IC Works CFO.

text.p: C-Cube Microsystems said late Tuesday that chief financial officer Jim Burke is resigning and will be succeeded by John Hagedorn, the former chief financial officer for IC Works.

The company said in a release that Burke joined C-Cube in 1992 as vice president of finance and chief financial officer and led it through a private round of fundraising, its initial public offering and a convertible note offering.
C-Cube gave no reason for Burke's resignation, but said he would act as a consultant to the company.
The company could not be immediately reached for further comment.
